content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR NGRI Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NGRI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSIR NGRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for CSIR NGRI Recruitment 2026 is 04-10-2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Technician-1 post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 21 vacancies for the Technician-1 post in CSIR NGRI Recruitment 2026. These vacancies are distributed across various trades.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification is SSC/10th Standard with Science subjects (minimum 55% marks) and an ITI Certificate in the relevant trade or equivalent apprenticeship/experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Technician-1 post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Technician-1 post is between 18 years and 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 500/-. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Trade Test followed by a Competitive Written Examination. The written exam has three papers covering mental ability, general awareness, English, and the concerned subject.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Technician-1 post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Technician-1 post will receive a salary of Rs. 39970 Per Month.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article. It contains detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST candidates, 3 years for OBC candidates, and other relaxations as mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of CSIR NGRI?
faq.answer: CSIR NGRI is located in Hyderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 500007.
